search_window.basis: Bounded supplementary recall since preceding hourly check; new concrete follow-up only. Primary daily Gaza collector/publisher remains authoritative.

findings.title: Israeli forces cut off Salah al-Din Road, bar movement in central Gaza
findings.publication_time_source: 07:13 PM (as displayed by WAFA; source local clock)
findings.location: Salah al-Din Road between Bureij and Nuseirat refugee camps, northeast of Nuseirat, central Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Dozens of displaced families reportedly moved west from west of Bureij and northeast of Nuseirat; road users and vehicles on Salah al-Din Road blocked; farmland/land and road corridor affected by armored vehicles, bulldozers, and earth mounds.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The developments triggered the displacement of dozens of families from areas west of the Bureij refugee camp and northeast of Nuseirat
findings.source_type: Named news agency's reporting by Gaza correspondent, direct attributed field reporting; Israeli military operation is also established in earlier Reuters and Al Jazeera coverage
findings.confidence: medium: WAFA field report of additional road closure and location-specific displacement; no independent confirmation of exact dozens-of-families count, extent of land clearance or duration of closure

discovery_context.first_seen_in_this_watch: WAFA latest index/direct article accessed after official OCHA OPT and WHO checks and 12 bounded searches
discovery_context.novelty: A 19:13 Palestine-local WAFA report (after the previous watch closed) says movement on Salah al-Din Road was barred, bulldozers levelled land and built earth mounds, and dozens of families fled west of Bureij / northeast Nuseirat. Prior 05:44 watch logged a central Gaza operation, an Al-Mughraqa fatality, families fleeing Al-Daawa and a partial road closure; this record is a bounded follow-up to the evolving movement/access and displacement effects, not a new operation or new fatality.
discovery_context.earlier_logged_overlap: November 18 05:44 PST military advance and displacement; prior 08:52 PST watch had no further findings. Existing fatalities not counted again.
discovery_context.corroboration_context: Earlier Reuters/Al Jazeera reporting establishes the operation and civilian displacement, but WAFA is the sole direct source inspected for the latest blocked-traffic, bulldozing and specific displacement-location details.
discovery_context.limitations: No confirmed independent total displaced, closure duration, civilian identities or geographic extent of bulldozing; do not infer permanent destruction or the start of a second military operation.

supplementary_direct_checks.detail: Current index contained November 18 19:13 Palestine-local Gaza road-closure and displacement report; article directly read and promoted as distinct follow-up.
Article directly describes armored advance, bulldozers leveling and earth mounds, complete road movement obstruction, and dozens of families displaced from areas not fully specified in prior run.
Confirms the larger central Gaza military operation and displacement, but reported deaths, road operation and prior Al-Mughraqa incident overlap earlier watches.
Read prior 08:44 run ending 08:52:43 PST; no qualifying findings. Compared that run with 07:44 and 05:44 documented overlap.

excluded_candidates: The November 18 two drone-strike fatalities in Deir al-Balah and Sheikh Ajlin were recorded in the November 17 23:48 PST run; no duplicate deaths carried forward.

The original Nuseirat/Al-Mughraqa military advance, Al-Mughraqa fatality, initial family displacement and partial Salah al-Din road closure were recorded by the 05:44 PST watch. Only newly reported specifics of worsened road restriction and additional location-specific displacement qualified here.
Erez aid truck inspection reopening recorded in 00:52 PST run; new actual Gaza aid entry or throughput not verified.
Abu Safiya detention extension recorded in 07:52 PST watch; no second detention event found.
WAFA November 18 oncology access feature is about West Bank patients in/around Beit Jala; excluded as outside Gaza.
Older November 13 OCHA reporting and older UNICEF/WHO results, unsourced claims and opinion excluded.
limitations: WHO Eastern Mediterranean continues failing with HTTP 502; OCHA OPT and WHO Global accessible, so watch completed in DEGRADED rather than FAILED state.
Search engine result ranking yielded older or recycled stories despite date constraints. Findings rely on source timestamps and directly opened articles.
One WAFA report provides the newly described effects; independently corroborated earlier operation is not evidence of exact new road-block or family-count detail.
A bounded supplementary watch does not establish that all contemporaneous incidents have been captured.
